issue.title: Enhancement: BGP tests changes for new DRH topologies

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

There are a few places where BGP tests need DRH specific changes:
- `setup_func` needs to be defined for LRH/URH
- `test_bgp_peer_shutdown.py`, `test_bgp_update_replication.py` & `test_bgp_update_timer.py` require changes to a) define neigh_type b) use_vtysh if `confed_asn` is present.

### Current Behavior

The above do not currently exist and thus DRH topos will fail.

### Proposed Behavior

- `setup_func` needs to be defined for LRH/URH - uses same as t1/t2.
    - Change the function name from `_setup_interfaces_t1_t2` -> `_setup_interfaces_t1_t2_drh` and attach LRH/URH behaviour
- `test_bgp_peer_shutdown.py`, `test_bgp_update_replication.py` & `test_bgp_update_timer.py`
    - Define neigh_type for LRH/URH respectively
    - use_vtysh if `confed_asn` is present.
